lesson: Sooryavanshi was covered but had been cut from 38% to 15% after team-level and recent-form evidence. Single-match player-of-the-match outcomes are highly variable; do not let modest team context overwhelm an individual player's exceptional upside.

The forecast omitted the immediate next decimal version within the Opus family and over-weighted a switch to Sonnet. Model-name markets should reserve meaningful probability for incremental releases in the incumbent family unless product sequencing evidence rules them out.
GlobalEye was covered at 35% behind the E-7 at 55%. The two-way concentration appropriately reflected procurement uncertainty, and retaining the credible non-US platform prevented a complete miss.

Pakistan was covered at 22% but trailed Bangladesh at 55%. A literal demolition order in Jammu and the western-border setting was more diagnostic than contextual Bangladesh fencing and holding-centre signals; exact operational wording should receive more weight.

The forecast concentrated on Premier League clubs and omitted Barcelona. Transfer markets require a globally scoped shortlist, with special weight on any continental giant linked by current negotiations rather than league familiarity alone.
